about: Held-out support tickets for measuring ticket reading (make eval-extraction). Written and labelled on 26 Sep 2026 before either reader was run on them, and committed before the first run, so the labels cannot have been fitted to the results. Written by the team, not by customers: harder than the generator's pools on purpose (Hinglish, negation, amounts, prompt injection), but still ours. `expect` lists every issue code that counts as a correct reading; an empty list means the ticket describes no operational problem and any event issue read from it is a false alarm.
